rule: General coverage and inconsistency theorems, explicit fixed models, composition of existing checked results
meaning: For one being at a world, the Metaphysics IX.6 potency reading and IsImmutable, each read at that world, with the open unattributed bridge ModalCapacity from accessible actuality to ability, give that no respect true of the being at an accessible world is false of it at that world. So with a decree of a field true at the world, at most one decree there, a decree at each accessible world and the decree sufficing for an effect at those worlds, the effect is not contingent at that world. With the same readings at a world from which a second is accessible, a respect true at the second is true at the first. For a contingent effect given a decree sufficing for it, with the potency reading, immutability and at most one decree at the world: some accessible world lacking the effect has no decree, or ModalCapacity fails. Named models delete each member of the second statement with the rest kept. Two controls bound the third: actualOnlyAct keeps the readings at false and fails immutability at true, and on noReturn the readings hold at both worlds while the decree differs and false is not accessible from true. The oneRespect model has the readings at both worlds with no respect sufficing for the effect, and twoTokens on the same ontology has strict efficacy of a directed token and a contingent effect. A one-member base has no marks of choice; with that member true throughout, base-fixed favouring, net selection and exactly one true field member at each accessible world, no field member is contingent; #742's acting has the marks on two necessary reasons, a contingent target and no net selection either way. With act necessity and a strict conditional from the act and a condition to a contingent effect, a true condition is contingent; no account of a contingent fact is reason-closed and founded with all reasons necessitating; #750's brute, chain and ground witness the other options; and the effect itself serves as such a condition, so a condition as such explains nothing. Nothing here asserts a reading, immutability or ModalCapacity, or that divine simplicity entails them, or that a decree is or is not a respect. No root premise is established.
